# Game Idea: Color Chase

A minimalist HTML‑canvas game where the player controls a small circle that can toggle between red and blue. Colored squares fall from the top; the player must collide with squares matching the circle’s current color. The game ends (lose condition) when the player hits a mismatched square or a square reaches the bottom.

1: // Simple Color Chase game with enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas element with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
6:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
7:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
8:   // Ensure audio context is resumed on user interaction
9:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
10:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, {once:true});
11:   canvas.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio, {once:true});
12: 
13:   const playTone = (frequency, duration = 0.1, type = 'sine') => {
14:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     oscillator.type = type;
17:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     oscillator.start();
21:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:   };
23: 
24:   const playSuccess = () => playTone(440, 0.08, 'triangle'); // bright tone
25:   const playFailure = () => playTone(150, 0.3, 'sawtooth'); // low thump
26: 
27:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
28:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
29:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
30:   // Full‑window canvas with high‑DPI support
31:   const resize = () => {
32:     const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
33:     canvas.width = (canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth) * dpr;
34:     canvas.height = (canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight) * dpr;
35:     ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
36:   };
37:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
38:   resize();
39: 
40:   const PLAYER_RADIUS = 15;
41:   const PLAYER_SPEED = 4;
42:   const SQUARE_SIZE = 30;
43:   const COLORS = ['red', 'blue'];
44: 
45:   const player = {
46:     x: canvas.width / 2,
47:     y: canvas.height - PLAYER_RADIUS - 10,
48:     radius: PLAYER_RADIUS,
49:     colorIndex: 0, // 0 -> red, 1 -> blue
50:   };
51: 
52:   let squares = [];
53:   let score = 0;
54:   let gameOver = false;
55:   let lastSpawn = 0;
56:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1000; // ms
57: 
58:   // Toggle player colour with Space bar or mouse click
59:   const toggleColor = () => {
60:     player.colorIndex = 1 - player.colorIndex;
61:   };
62:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
63:     if (e.code === 'Space') toggleColor();
64:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED;
65:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') player.x += PLAYER_SPEED;
66:   });
67:   canvas.addEventListener('click', toggleColor);
68: 
69:   const spawnSquare = () => {
70:     const size = SQUARE_SIZE;
71:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size) + size / 2;
72:     squares.push({
73:       x,
74:       y: -size,
75:       size,
76:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
77:       color: COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * COLORS.length)],
78:     });
79:   };
80: 
81:   const rectCircleCollide = (rect, circle) => {
82:     const distX = Math.abs(circle.x - rect.x);
83:     const distY = Math.abs(circle.y - rect.y);
84:     if (distX > rect.size / 2 + circle.radius) return false;
85:     if (distY > rect.size / 2 + circle.radius) return false;
86:     if (distX <= rect.size / 2) return true;
87:     if (distY <= rect.size / 2) return true;
88:     const dx = distX - rect.size / 2;
89:     const dy = distY - rect.size / 2;
90:     return dx * dx + dy * dy <= circle.radius * circle.radius;
91:   };
92: 
93:   const update = (timestamp) => {
94:     if (gameOver) {
95:       ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
96:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
97:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
98:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
99:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
100:       ctx.fillText(`Game Over! Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
101:       return;
102:     }
103: 
104:     // Spawn squares
105:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
106:       spawnSquare();
107:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
108:     }
109: 
110:     // Move squares
111:     squares.forEach(s => s.y += s.speed);
112: 
113:     // Collision detection & removal
114:     squares = squares.filter(s => {
115:       // Bottom loss
116:       if (s.y - s.size / 2 > canvas.height) {
117:         gameOver = true;
118:         return false;
119:       }
120:       // Collision with player
121:       const collided = rectCircleCollide({ x: s.x, y: s.y, size: s.size }, player);
122:       if (collided) {
123:         if (s.color === COLORS[player.colorIndex]) {
124:           score++;
125:           playSuccess();
126:           return false; // remove matched square
127:         } else {
128:           gameOver = true;
129:           playFailure();
130:           return false;
131:         }
132:       }
133:       return true;
134:     });
135: 
136:     // Draw background gradient
137:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
138:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#222');
139:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
140:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
141:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
142: 
143:     // Draw player with radial gradient and shadow
144:     ctx.save();
145:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
146:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
147:     const playerGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
148:       player.x, player.y, player.radius * 0.3,
149:       player.x, player.y, player.radius
150:     );
151:     const playerColor = COLORS[player.colorIndex];
152:     playerGrad.addColorStop(0, 'white');
153:     playerGrad.addColorStop(1, playerColor);
154:     ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
155:     ctx.beginPath();
156:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
157:     ctx.fill();
158:     ctx.restore();
159: 
160:     // Helper to draw rounded square
161:     const drawRoundedRect = (x, y, size, radius, fillStyle) => {
162:       ctx.save();
163:       ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
164:       ctx.beginPath();
165:       ctx.moveTo(x - size / 2 + radius, y - size / 2);
166:       ctx.lineTo(x + size / 2 - radius, y - size / 2);
167:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + size / 2, y - size / 2, x + size / 2, y - size / 2 + radius);
168:       ctx.lineTo(x + size / 2, y + size / 2 - radius);
169:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + size / 2, y + size / 2, x + size / 2 - radius, y + size / 2);
170:       ctx.lineTo(x - size / 2 + radius, y + size / 2);
171:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - size / 2, y + size / 2, x - size / 2, y + size / 2 - radius);
172:       ctx.lineTo(x - size / 2, y - size / 2 + radius);
173:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - size / 2, y - size / 2, x - size / 2 + radius, y - size / 2);
174:       ctx.closePath();
175:       ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
176:       ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
177:       ctx.fill();
178:       ctx.restore();
179:     };
180: 
181:     // Squares with rounded corners
182:     squares.forEach(s => {
183:       drawRoundedRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, 4, s.color);
184:     });
185: 
186:     // Score overlay
187:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
188:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
189:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
190:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
191: 
192:     requestAnimationFrame(update);
193:   };
194: 
195:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
196: })();

(End of file - total 196 lines)
</content>
